findings.failure_path: Each nonexistent nonempty log root is silently skipped. With `--logs /missing,/valid`, the script scans only `/valid`, prints a table plus `reference_access_census_ok`, and exits 0; with only `/missing`, it reports the no-transcripts sentinel and exits 0. Both conceal an explicitly requested missing input instead of satisfying the stated exit-2, table-withholding contract.
findings.smallest_fix: Distinguish explicitly supplied log roots from absent optional defaults, record each missing explicit root as a count-only input error, and call `withhold_if_errors` before scanning. Add path-leak-safe tests for both missing-only and mixed missing/valid roots, asserting exit 2, no table, and no ok token.
